blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo ler, ouvir, falar e escrever uma biografia filosófica de Immanuel Kant, usando passado perfeito, aposto e linguagem de síntese, com entonação adequada.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.name: Immanuel Kant (1724–1804)
paras: Immanuel Kant, **born** in Königsberg, **spent** nearly his whole life in that Prussian city. By the time he **published** the *Critique of Pure Reason* in 1781, he **had taught** for years; the book, **a landmark of modern philosophy**, **argued** that the mind **actively shapes** experience instead of passively receiving it.

**Having laid** the foundations of his theory of knowledge, Kant **turned to** ethics. His *Groundwork of the Metaphysics of Morals* (1785) **set out** the **categorical imperative**: act only on principles you could **will as universal laws**. **Regarded** by many as the **pivot** between Enlightenment and later idealism, he **remained** a punctual, **austere** teacher until his death.

items.q: Kant published the Critique of Pure Reason in 1781.

items.why: spent nearly his whole life in that city.

items.q: Kant wrote his ethics before his theory of knowledge.
items.why: The text says he turned to ethics after laying foundations.

blocks.body: Biografias combinam **passado simples** (eventos principais) com **passado perfeito** (o que veio antes) e **apostos** entre vírgulas. A voz desce nos fatos e faz uma pausa curta antes e depois do aposto.
O aposto fica entre **vírgulas**: *Kant, a Prussian philosopher, wrote…*. Sem vírgulas vira restrição de sentido.

items.s: ___ laid the foundations, Kant turned to ethics. (having)
The book, a ___ of modern philosophy, argued… (landmark)
He ___ a punctual teacher until his death. (remain)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: And the Critique of Pure Reason
items.pt: E a Crítica da Razão Pura?
O que é o imperativo categórico?

body: **A landmark of…** — Um marco de…
**Lay the foundations.** — Lançar as bases.
**Turn to.** — Voltar-se para.
**Set out.** — Expor.
**By the time…** — Quando…
**Regarded as.** — Considerado como.
**Stand the test of time.** — Resistir ao tempo.
**Leave a lasting mark.** — Deixar marca duradoura.
**Ahead of one’s time.** — À frente do seu tempo.
**Dare to know.** — Ousar saber.
**What is the categorical imperative?** — O que é o imperativo categórico?
**And the Critique of Pure Reason?** — E a Crítica da Razão Pura?
**Act only on principles you could will as universal laws.** — Aja apenas segundo princípios que você poderia querer como leis universais.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence biography of a thinker or writer you admire (real, with facts you are sure of), using the past perfect, an appositive and Having + participle.
blocks.model: Marie Curie, a physicist and chemist, was born in Warsaw in 1867. By 1903 she had begun research on radioactivity. Having shared a Nobel Prize in physics, she later won another in chemistry in 1911. Regarded as a pioneer, she remained devoted to science. She died in 1934.

items.q: What does “Critique of Pure Reason” mean?
items.why: **Critique of Pure Reason** = Crítica da Razão Pura.
